narrative: The benchmark's dominant failure was agents self-stopping after their own pre-finish checks declared success against a weaker target than the task required - a textbook coherence drift where an agent's internal sense of done detaches from its goal. Measured across four frontier models, that drift reads as the binding constraint, motivating exactly the trajectory-level probes the prediction expects to standardize.
remaining_gap: The study quantifies the drift but ships no standardized trajectory-probe audit primitive; that productization is still unbuilt.
